meta_title: About – Oysterdale Records | Norwegian House & Disco Label
meta_description: Oysterdale Records is an independent Norwegian house and disco label based in Oslo. Founded by Kevin Vadsten, we release club-first house music, disco, and funky grooves. Every record is a pearl.
